🕴️ Pose: Confident Arms Crossed
Standing with arms crossed over the chest — a self-assured posture projecting control and composure.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Confident Arms Crossed.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, fold the arms comfortably across the chest, square the shoulders, keep the chin level, and shift the visible posture slightly back with controlled confidence. Female: shoulders held level, elbows close to the ribs, weight settled onto one hip. Male: shoulders squared, elbows carried out, weight even. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own confident carriage.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
